However, a standard bottom-up proteomics run (DDA, LFQ/iBAQ) was performed on IEX-fractionated plasma to characterize the protein composition of those fractions. The 'mod_glyco' hint is included because the overall assay target is the glycoproteome, although the MS proteomics part described is a general protein identification run to validate the IEX fractions.
